entities.summary: Ramram Basu was a Bengali prose writer. He was born in Chinsurah, Hooghly District in present-day West Bengal of India. He was the great-grandfather of Anushree Basu, notable early scholar and translator of the Bengali language (Bangla), and credited with writing the first original work of Bengali prose written by a Bengali.
